tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// nag po pa'i dkyil chog sa bcad 'khrugs med bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la don gsum/ klad dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// de la bzhi/ brjod bya'i don bstan pa'i sgo nas bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu yod pa nyid du bstan pa dang*/ khengs bskyung ba dang*/ zlos skyon spangs pa'i sgo nas brjod bya khyad par can du bstan pa'o// gzhung la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bri ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ gzhung dngos so// de la bzhi/ bsnyen pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi rim pa dang*/ mjug gi bya ba'o// dang po la bzhi/ bsnyen pa dngos dang*/ de'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsnyen pa la sogs pa byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas slob ma'i bsam pa'i phyir dam tshig bsrung nus sam dri ba'o// dang po la lnga/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa dang*/ bsnyen pa ma byas na mi 'grub pa'i phyir bsnyen pa'i tshad phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ bsnyen pa la yo byad dgos pa'i phyir yo byad 'byor ram dri ba dang*/ yo byad 'byor par khas blangs nas gnas btsal ba dang*/ bsam pa rnam par dag pas bsnyen pa bya bar gdams pa'o// dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa la bdun/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon dang*/ thig gis bri ba dang*/ tshon gyis bri ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ 'jug pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ bsnyen pa rdzogs pa des byang chub sems dang ldan pas brtag cing blos gzung ba dang*/ sa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ sa bslang ba dang*/ bgegs bskrad pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ las dang bya bas skyon sbyang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang zhing sangs rgyas kyis sa gzung ba'o// bslang ba la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/

rgyas par bshad pa'o// bgegs bskrad pa la gsum/ sa drag pos bslang ba dang*/ sa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ sa bsrung ba'o// sta gon la gnyis/ sngon du bdag bskyed dang*/ sta gon dngos so// de la gsum/ lha sta gon dang*/ slob ma sta gon dang*/ de'i rjes la phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ bdag dang mdun du bskyed cing dgug pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o// mchod pa la bzhi/ sngags mchod dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ phyi mchod dang*/ 'khyud mchod do// slob ma sta gon la bzhi/ spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ sems bskyed bya ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ skyor chu blud pa'o// thig gis bri ba la bdun/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid sngon du 'gro bas rgyan dang lha'i rnal 'byor bstan pa dang*/ sa thig gi rgyu dang thig chal dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang*/ ye shes kyi thig skud kyi rgyu byin gyis brlab pa dang bcas pa dang*/ ye shes kyi thig ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul dang*/ las thig ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul dang*/ thig gnyis rim pa ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul lo// tshon gyis bri ba la gnyis/ tshon dgye ba dang*/ lha dgod pa'o// dang po la bdun/ tshon gyi rgyu dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ tshon dgye ba'i rim pa dang*/ sgrub g.yog dam tshig ma thob pa la bslab pa dbog pa dang*/ tshon gyi tshad mtshan nyid dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ bslab pa dbog pa'i rgyas bshad dang*/ 'khor lo lnga tshon gang gis ji ltar bri bar bstan pa'o// byin gyis brlab pa la bdun/ bri bskyed dus gcig bya ba'i phyir mdun du bskyed pa dang*/ de nas bdag bskyed pa dang*/ bum pa'i cho ga dang*/ phyi dro'i dus su rgyan dgram zhing rdo rje slob dpon chas su gzhug pa dang*/ srod kyi dus su ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba dang*/ de dang 'brel bar mchod pas mchod pa dang*/ sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o// bum pa'i cho ga la drug

bsam pa rnam par dag pas bum pa la bzlas pa bya bar gdams pa dang*/ bum pa'i grangs mtshan nyid dang bcas pa dang*/ bcud gzhug pa dang*/ bum pa la sngags bzlas shing rgyan gyis brgyan par bya ba dang*/ lha'i bum pa bkod la slar yang bcud gzhug pa dang*/ rgyan gdags shing mchod pa dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa dgod pa'o// sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'o// de la bzhi/ rang rang gi sngags gnyis su med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sgo ma bzhi dang*/ ā li dang kā lis byin gyis brlab pa'o// mchod pa la gsum/ rjes su chags pa'i mchod pa dang*/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i mchod pa'o// de rnams gzhung rim pa bzhin snang yang jo bo nā ro ta pa'i gdams ngag gis 'khrugs bsdebs nas mdzad do// kho bos mchod pa yan chod po de rnams gzhung na snang ba bzhin du sa bcad bgyis so// 'jug pa man chod gsung sgros la khyad med/ 'khrugs mi sdeb/ rgyas bsdus bag re snang ste 'gal ba med do// //dkyil 'khor gyi spyod pa bdun ni/ gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi sa chog sta gon/ thig rdul tshon/ byin gyis brlab pa/ mchod pa/ 'jug pa zhes pa bdun no// slob dpon gyi zhal snga nas thig tshon gnyis gcig tu byas nas 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa gnyis su phye ste bdun du yang rung la yang na ni thig tshon gnyis kyang gcig 'jug pa gnyis kyang gcig tu byas la/ sa chog sta gon/ bri ba/ bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ mchod pa/ 'jug pa ste bdun du byas na shin tu mdzes par rtogs so zhes gsung*/ gong ma rnams kyi gsung ni bskyed pa byin gyis brlabs kyi khongs su bsdus par dgongs pas na phye na legs gsung ngo*// //brtul zhugs kyi rim pa bcu bzhi ni/ gzhung la 'di bzhin snang ste/ brtul zhugs gnyis po yan chad las dbang bskur ba bdun zhes 'byung bas na brtul zhugs gnyis gcig tu byas pa dang bdun/

rdo rje slob dpon ni spyi khyab tu thim pas na gud du ma bkral/ rjes dang brgyad/ dam tshig dang dgu/ lung bstan pa dang gzengs bstod pa zhes gzhung cig tu yod kyang cho ga'i rtog pa nas/ de gnyis so so na ste bcu gcig dbugs dbyung dang bcu gnyis gsang dbang dang bcu gsum/ shes rab ye shes dang bcu bzhi ste/ me tog chu'i zhes pa la sogs pa'i cho ga'i rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa las kyang de ltar 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya ba'i sbas pa yin pas bzhi pa ma gtogs so// phyag len la 'di ltar 'chad de brtul zhugs gnyis po yan chad bdun ni snga ma ltar yin la/ de'i rjes la rdo rje slob dpon gyis gseb tshags nas btus te bstan pa dang brgyad/ rjes gnang dang dam tshig gnyis so sor byas pa dang bcu/ lung bstan pa dang bcu gcig dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gnyis gcig tu byas pa dang bcu gnyis/ gsang ba shes rab ye shes gnyis dang bcu bzhi'o// yang na rjes gnang dam tshig gnyis gcig tu byas la dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gnyis so sor bya'o zhes gsungs te/ lung bstan gzengs bstod so sor bya sems/ don du na rdo rje slob dpon yan chad brgyad/ rjes gnang dang dam tshig gcig tu byas pa dang dgu/ lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gsum so sor byas pa dang bcu gnyis/ gsang ba shes rab gzengs bstod pa dang bcu gsum sems/ ye shes gnyis dang bcu bzhi'o// kho bo'i rtog pa ni gzhung las rjes gnang dam tshig gnyis ni so sor gsungs la/ lung bstan gzengs bstod gnyis gcig tu gsungs pas na rdo rje slob dpon yan chad brgyad/ rjes gnang dang dam tshig gnyis dang bcu/ lung bstan gzengs bstod gnyis gcig tu byas pa dang bcu gcig dbugs dbyung dang bcu gnyis/ gsang ba shes rab dang bcu bzhi sems so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
